11 June 2026

Monetary policy decisions

The Governing Council today decided to keep the three key ECB interest rates unchanged.

Key ECB interest rates

The interest rate on the main refinancing operations and the interest rates on the marginal lending facility and the deposit facility remain at 2.00%, 2.25% and 1.75% respectively.

The monetary policy press conference will take place on 12 June 2026 at the ECB's premises.

European Central Bank, 2026
